role_routing_factorial.definition: Query and history refer to the two operands of the inherited aligned category/brand product. Factor level0 uses the own-event full normalization VJP; level1 applies the existing detached inverse-norm-ranked half-rotation tangent rule on that operand. Both factors retain the same forward at a fixed common state; separately trained checkpoints need not predict identically.
role_routing_factorial.interpretation: Positive AUC nonadditivity and negative loss nonadditivity match the declared coordination direction at this seed. Query-only is nearly full in AUC with worse loss; history-only lowers AUC but slightly improves loss. Both factors together lead these four cells in both metrics. This is a finite difference of optimized, checkpoint-selected validation outcomes; it is neither a decomposition of gradient cancellation nor proof of a unique underlying mechanism.
role_routing_factorial.conditional_attribution: Missing single-role cells have identical-Model-AST declarations and literal-config differences; endpoints are historical source/config bridges. Candidate common-state/synthetic checks support intended isolation within their measured scope. Independent actual source/state inspection and paired seed repetition remain absent.

slice_analysis.scope: All23 inherited slices below are exploratory; no bin is created or tuned from the new outcomes. Counts are exposures, not independent users; slices overlap. AUC cannot be weighted over slices to recover global AUC or its interaction.
slice_analysis.bin_provenance: Inherited host labels/bins. Exact threshold construction and category-match details cannot be independently inspected in this phase. History limit128 truncates observable histories.
slice_analysis.confirmatory_status: The aggregate factorial direction was prospectively declared in latest knowledge usage. Slice interactions were not; treat all as exploratory.
slice_analysis.observations: The dominant history_gt64 slice has3,026,583 impressions and151,372 positives, with positive AUC interaction0.00027945. Short history1-16, history17-64, cart-absent and highest-frequency groups have negative AUC interaction. Both routing still harms empty/short-history, low-frequency and some hour/category groups relative to full. The highest-frequency group has positive AUC simple effects for each single-role intervention but a negative interaction. Empty-history differences arise after retraining shared parameters despite zero direct history summary; they do not imply relevant events exist.
slice_analysis.low_information: Empty history has310 positives; pv-absent397; frequency1-2 has1,045. Both label classes exist, so AUC is computable, but reliable subgroup-effect claims are unsupported. No minimum power threshold was predeclared.
slice_analysis.missing: No missing/unseen-field slices or per-user prediction archive are exported.

observations.statement: All45 exposed model trials succeeded with null errors; latest runtime error is null. Scientific null/negative branches and repaired preparation failures are retained separately.
History pooling improves static AUC by0.0052224992; target-aware pooling adds0.0031358724. This establishes useful history signal under this benchmark, not semantic relevance.
Full count correction hurts pooling and target-aware AUC. Half correction helps pooling but still hurts target-aware AUC. The partial follow-up did not rescue that mechanism.

Aligned raw product restrictions improve the ordinary adapter; off-diagonal removal alone also helps. Unit normalization helps aligned AUC far more than crossed AUC. Original DIN differs from the ordinary adapter and cannot replace its immediate control.

Detached, identity and tangent-only replacements failed to beat full normalized aligned. Fixed0.2 tangent/identity later nearly recover full AUC. Exact own-event inverse scales and tangent projection have not been shown necessary.

Chronological half-rotation, action-half and action-mean lose AUC; whole-history mean is near full but worse in loss. Adjacent replacements recover in both groupings. Rank ordering reverses the chronological adjacent-versus-half AUC ordering. These failures limit individual implementations, not all multi-behavior modeling.
Query-only routing AUC0.6149975213 is nearly full with worse loss; history-only AUC0.6148160125 is lower with slightly better loss. Neither improves incumbent AUC0.6151021885 or its loss0.1965325839.

The role factorial AUC interaction is+0.00027034593078789637; Logloss interaction is-0.00005161847028653521. Both routing beats the additive AUC prediction0.6148318426. The prospectively declared sign is observed at this single seed.
Candidate diagnostics report common-state forward equality and accurate synthetic role VJPs; bounded measurements do not supply training-role cancellation or actual update evidence.

Earlier two training-BCE probes already showed changed product and selected shared embedding VJPs; the new interventions now vary roles during training, but no new training-loss path decomposition is reported.

Aggregate interaction is heterogeneous across exploratory counted slices; the same role interaction is not positive in every group. Empty-history score changes cannot be direct effects of attended history events.

All four role cells have17,130,275 parameters. Single-role wall times625.06/629.62s and peaks871,668,224/872,716,288 bytes do not establish an efficiency gain. Historical both/full timing uses different source implementations and instrumentation.

interpretations.statement: The declared local coordination prediction gains conditional single-seed controlled support: the role interventions have a positive AUC finite-difference interaction and a favorable negative loss interaction.
interpretations.qualification: Performance nonadditivity only, conditional on historical endpoint/source isolation. No repeated support or uniquely identified mechanism.

interpretations.statement: Independent additive contribution of each operand is inadequate as a description of these optimized validation outcomes: the history intervention lowers AUC when query is own but raises it when query is half.
interpretations.qualification: This is descriptive effect modification on the AUC scale, not a claim of additive gradient vectors or causal mediation.

interpretations.statement: Shared-table gradient coordination/cancellation remains a plausible explanation, alongside nonlinear optimization, unchanged direct/attention paths, Adam moments and checkpoint selection. The factorial does not distinguish them.

The role-specific intervention is mechanism-distinct from changing query construction or adding forward capacity: reported same-state predictions and capacity are fixed while operand backward rules differ.
interpretations.qualification: Source bodies are not exported in this phase; assertion is conditional on receipt and synthetic checks, not independent full-model proof.

interpretations.statement: Uniform benefit, necessary temporal adjacency, necessary exact own-event scaling and semantic relevance are not established; earlier failed contrasts and new subgroup exceptions remain counterevidence to stronger accounts.
Round15 adds missing factorial cells, not a better selected model or an independent initialization. Current numerical incumbent and best loss model remain unchanged.

regular_event_algebra.definitions: For regular nonfloored events, p_j=q_c*h_cj+q_b*h_bj (elementwise), u_j=p_j/||p_j||, P_j=I-u_j*u_j^T, s_j=1/||p_j||.

regular_event_algebra.scope: Floored/boundary/padded events and exact tie/rotation direction require source verification. Sum/squared-sum conservation concerns scalar donors, not accumulated gradients, updates or optimizer energy.
